verdicts.reason: A shoves the whole block into the lower-left with a dead top half. Its quote mark has shrunk to a speck, the quote text is small, and the bold attribution is jammed right under the quote at nearly the same visual weight, so the hierarchy is flattened. B keeps the original's left-aligned, vertically balanced structure, with a properly sized quote mark, a readable two-line quote and good spacing, but its attribution has shrunk to near-illegible micro text at 300x250.
